visible_text: Astra を自動で見つけられません
Astraをご自宅のネットワーク上で
「Astra をオフに」してください

observation.happening: Error dialog displayed. System cannot auto-detect Astra. User is shown instruction text and offered action to open System Settings.
observation.most_important: Astra auto-detection failed; user is prompted to open System Settings to resolve.
observation.next_action: User clicks 'システム設定を開く' button or closes dialog with X.
anomalies: Instruction text appears cut off or awkwardly wrapped across lines
Logical contradiction: told Astra cannot be detected, yet instruction mentions 'turn Astra off'—unclear why
Text line break positioning makes the full instruction hard to parse

concerns.what: Recovery instruction is confusing: if Astra cannot be auto-detected, why instruct to turn it off? The connection between problem and solution is unclear.
concerns.where: Second and third lines of instruction text

concerns.what: Text wrapping or truncation makes the instruction hard to read. Line breaks fragment the message across multiple lines in a way that reduces clarity.
